answer_1.quote: We investigate generating positive moderation using instructions derived from professional moderation guidelines to prompt LLaMA models

answer_2.quote: We prompt LLaMA based on G-Eval to generate an evaluation of the moderation text

answer_3.quote: We prompt LLaMA to generate a Likert scale evaluation of the moderation reply comment and extract scores based on the generated answer

answer_4.quote: We conduct two annotation studies which allow us to better understand the phenomenon and evaluate the generation... The first (Sec. 4.1) targets the assessment... and the second (Sec. 4.2) is a preference task
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluate based on criteria such as fitting, actions clarity, issues, etc., using a Likert scale
